label.description: A new label for the Canvas

tags.description: Map of tag id to its full description for every tag referenced by the Canvas nodes and edges

canvas_id.description: The ID of the Canvas that contains this Canvas Node

data_id.description: The Data Node ID associated with this Canvas Node

ref.description: The id of the underlying data entity (e.g. the node CURIE)

label.description: The user friendly label for this Canvas Node

type.description: The Biolink Type for this Canvas Node

x.description: The x-coordinate on the Canvas that contains this Canvas Node

y.description: The y-coordinate on the Canvas that contains this Canvas Node

hidden.description: A flag for if this Canvas Node is hidden

tags.description: Map of tag labels to null (tags are defined in the Canvas tags property)

time_created.description: The time this Canvas Node was created

time_updated.description: The last time this Canvas Node was edited

time_deleted.description: When this Canvas Node was soft deleted, or null if active

canvas_id.description: The ID of the Canvas that contains this Canvas Edge

data_id.description: The Data Edge ID associated with this Canvas Edge

subject_id.description: The Canvas Node ID for the subject of this Canvas Edge

object_id.description: The Canvas Node ID for the object of this Canvas Edge

ref.description: The id of the underlying data entity (e.g. the edge id)

label.description: The user friendly label for this Canvas Edge

hidden.description: A flag for if this Canvas Edge is hidden

tags.description: Map of tag labels to null (tags are defined in the Canvas tags property)

time_created.description: The time this Canvas Edge was created

time_updated.description: The last time this Canvas Edge was edited

time_deleted.description: When this Canvas Edge was soft deleted, or null if active

id.description: The ID of this Canvas Annotation

canvas_id.description: The ID of the Canvas that contains this Canvas Annotation

content.description: The text contained in this Canvas Annotation

x.description: The x-coordinate on the Canvas that contains this Canvas Annotation

y.description: The y-coordinate on the Canvas that contains this Canvas Annotation

width.description: The width of this Canvas Annotation

height.description: The height of this Canvas Annotation

time_created.description: The time this Canvas Annotation was created

time_updated.description: The last time this Canvas Annotation was edited

time_deleted.description: When this Canvas Annotation was soft deleted, or null if active

GraphNode.description: A node submitted as part of a canvas Graph

x.description: The x-coordinate for this node on the canvas

y.description: The y-coordinate for this node on the canvas

hidden.description: Whether this node is hidden on the canvas

GraphEdge.description: An edge submitted as part of a canvas Graph

hidden.description: Whether this edge is hidden on the canvas

UpdateCanvasElementRequest.description: A partial update of a Canvas Node or Edge's display properties; only the fields present are changed. Node position is updated through the dedicated move endpoint, not here.

label.description: A new display label for the Canvas Node or Edge

hidden.description: Whether the Canvas Node or Edge is hidden on the canvas

GraphSelection.description: A selection of Canvas Node and Edge data ids and Canvas Annotation ids to soft delete or restore. At least one id across the three collections is required. Soft deleting a node also soft deletes every edge attached to it; restoring an edge requires both of its endpoint nodes to be active. Annotations are independent: they neither cascade nor depend on anything else.

nodes.description: The data ids of the Canvas Nodes to soft delete or restore

edges.description: The data ids of the Canvas Edges to soft delete or restore

annotations.description: The ids of the Canvas Annotations to soft delete or restore

CreateAnnotationRequest.description: A new Canvas Annotation. Content and the full rectangle are all required; null is not accepted for any field.

x.description: The x-coordinate for the annotation on the canvas

y.description: The y-coordinate for the annotation on the canvas

UpdateAnnotationContentRequest.description: A new body of text for a Canvas Annotation. Position and size are updated through the graph geometry endpoint, not here.

content.description: The new text for the annotation

GraphGeometry.description: New positions for Canvas Nodes and new rectangles for Canvas Annotations. Both collections are optional but at least one must be non-empty.

data_id.description: The data id of the Canvas Node to move

x.description: The new x-coordinate for the node on the canvas

y.description: The new y-coordinate for the node on the canvas

nodes.description: The Canvas Nodes to move with their new positions

id.description: The id of the Canvas Annotation to place

x.description: The new x-coordinate for the annotation on the canvas

y.description: The new y-coordinate for the annotation on the canvas

width.description: The new width of the annotation. Omit to leave the stored width unchanged; must be sent together with height and must not be null.

height.description: The new height of the annotation. Omit to leave the stored height unchanged; must be sent together with width and must not be null.

annotations.description: The Canvas Annotations to place. Position (x, y) is required on every entry. Size (width, height) is optional and must be supplied as a pair. Send both to resize, or omit both to leave the stored size untouched. null is never accepted for any of the four fields; omitting a field is the only way to leave it unchanged.

CanvasGeometry.description: The Canvas Nodes and Canvas Annotations that were updated by a geometry request
